answer: Anchor each new participant to one record of completed work, verified by an independent reviewer within 48 hours, that must grow through slow sequential tasks, each checked by a different reviewer. A genuine participant can wander freely across services, but a forger wanting a thousand lookalikes must fabricate a thousand histories, pass a thousand checks, and wait out the same slow sequence for each. A duplicate is struck from the basalt ledger of trusted identities, and its reviewer loses standing, so forgery costs far more time and scrutiny than honest participation.
